name: Window Chrome
tagline: Build diary told inside an app window: graphite canvas in window chrome, white Instrument Serif over real artboards, cut-outs breaking out over the frame; apricot and cream caption pages between.
whenToUse: Spine D build diaries: 'how I built X in N steps', 'build your X with Claude Code'
Spine A explainers of one tool shown inside its own window
Raw-to-refined process rows (rough input above, real result pieces below)

fonts.serif: Instrument Serif (Google) — every headline, sentence, caption and label; accent words take the italic cut only
fonts.ui: Inter Medium — window chrome labels, counter pill, caption-page footer
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono — exact-text cards (30 px floor)

palette.chrome: #4A4A4A title + control bar, #3F3F3F tab row, #474747 rail
palette.orange: #D9551F UI accents only (active tab line, rail marker, counter dot, selection boxes)

kinds.chrome: layout: cover | stage | process | command | parts; frame = the HTML kit (default) or a real 4:5 window capture (frame.src + frame.canvas)
kinds.result: apricot: sentence + one large artboard with a warm shadow, or a SCENE plate full-bleed (plate)
kinds.zoom: cream: sentence + one 605 x 907 artboard with an HTML selection box
kinds.cta: apricot: Comment {keyword} + what they get + hero cut-out on a contact shadow

slideFields: artboards[{src, aspect, focus, focusFill, select, fit, bg, span, card{text|html, size, w}}]
cutouts[{src, x, y, w, scale, rotation, shadow, anchor, dx, dy}]

files.slides.html: copy to carousels/<id>/slides.html, edit DECK + slides[] at the bottom
